question: DEF eco round Split, 5v5, ATK full-buy, you are Cypher on pistol. How do you play the eco to maximize your round-steal chances?

options.label: Stack 2-3 players close-range at Mid/Vents for a coordinated close duel, with trap/cam covering the other site
options.explication_courte: On a DEF eco your only advantage is close-range grouping: stacking Mid/Vents forces a short-range duel where pistols compete with rifles and Cypher's util covers the rest.

options.label: Play a default 5-position defense and try to retake post-plant with pistols
options.explication_courte: A default eco defense that plays for a post-plant retake is viable for gathering utility, but a pistol retake against full-buy rifles is a hard hill to climb.

sources_option.citation: On an eco, spreading into standard default positions and trying to retake with pistols against a full-buy is lower-EV than concentrating force for a close-range steal.

options.label: Spread all 5 solos across every entry to cover the whole map
options.explication_courte: Spreading 5 pistols into solo duels at range hands the full-buy ATK exactly the fights they want: every 1v1 at distance is losing.

sources_option.citation: On a save/eco round, spreading players into solo long-range duels plays into the full-buy's rifle advantage; concentration at close range is the eco's only edge.

options.label: Rush A Main grouped to attack ATK spawn before they set up
options.explication_courte: Rushing DEF toward the ATK spawn runs into full-buy rifles in open ground: you offer 5 pistol duels at range against rifles in their territory.

sources_option.citation: Rushing out toward the attacker spawn on an eco runs pistols into rifles in open space and wastes the round with no economic damage dealt.

explication_longue:
Situation: DEF eco round Split, 5v5, ATK full-buy, you are Cypher on pistol with Trapwire, Cyber Cage, Spycam. The goal of an eco is not to guarantee the win but to maximize EV: steal the round or grab rifles.

On Split, the correct eco line is to stack 2-3 players at Mid/Vents where the choke forces close-range duels - the only range where pistols are competitive against rifles. Cypher's Trapwire covers the other site entry for free intel, and the grouped close play either wins the exchange or takes a rifle for the next round.

Default 5-position defense (acceptable) is viable but a pistol post-plant retake against full rifles is a hard outcome. Spreading 5 solos (costly) is the classic eco mistake: every solo duel at range against a rifle is lost. Rushing ATK spawn (mistake) runs pistols into rifles in open ground - the worst possible eco outcome.

Estimated elite distribution: ~52% Mid/Vents close stack, ~23% default eco defense, ~17% spread solos (costly), ~6% rush spawn (mistake).

sources.citation: Eco rounds are won by concentration and close-range engagements plus one piece of info, not by spreading pistols into long-range duels against rifles.
The eco's only edge is concentrated close-range force; spreading solo plays into the full-buy's rifle advantage at distance.
Mid and Vents on Split are tight close-range areas ideal for stacking an eco push where pistol groups can neutralise the rifle advantage.

_gaps.incertitude: Estimations depuis guides eco (mobalytics, boostroom) + Split (thunderpick) ; le spread solo (~24%) est un couteux frequent en soloq, la repartition exacte varie par elo sans dataset public.
Le choix du cote a stacker (Mid/Vents vs un site) est un read non encode ; ici Mid est choisi comme terrain close-range par defaut de la map.
Le spread solo (couteux) a une freq >= 15 : classe couteux et non acceptable car son EV reste negatif malgre sa popularite soloq — frontiere que trancherait un juge.
